limitations: Synthetic rollback-only software evidence; not real-data HR acceptance.
Unit parents must already exist; import parent groups before children.
Existing global job-title collisions require explicit reviewed target selection; no same-title guessing.
Immutable external identities have no alias-replacement or company-migration operation.
Native UI controls are implemented; AR/EN browser evidence is separately owned by QA.
checked_at_note: Exact suite execution timestamp was not captured. Successful run preceded evidence creation; evidence_recorded_at is metadata completion time, not execution time.
source_unchanged_scope: Recorded source_hashes were captured immediately following the successful suite, with product source frozen throughout handoff; this check compares precisely those listed organization/controller/schema/JS/hooks files with current files. It is not a blanket claim about the entire application or unrelated team changes.
follow_up_note: Prior successful functional gate is preserved at its recorded hashes. Subsequent peer review found an old-RR-snapshot native target guard gap; codes.py now uses current target+registry locks. Independent connection proof is tracked separately; this file is not silently reattributed to that new source.
